name: Fungal Horror
special: Orange fungal mass surrounding An-Rah's skeleton.
Regenerates 3 HP every round unless damaged by fire or acid.
Sensitive to noise. Breaks out of anti-entropy sphere if it hears movement.
Defeating the Horror allows the looting of Nassak An-Rah's skeleton.

resistances.notes: Regenerates 3 HP every round unless damaged by fire or acid (regeneration is negated by fire or acid damage). No immunity or resistance stated.

combat_note: Regeneration only stops when hit with fire or acid; otherwise heals 3 HP/round.
raw_excerpt: FungalHorror Fungal Level AV Morale 4 11 +10 Attack:Crush(d8)/AcidSpit(d8) OrangefungalmasssurroundingAn-Rah's skeleton. Regenerates3HPeveryroundunlessdamagedbyfire oracid.

name: Glass Centipede
special: Four-foot centipede with translucent flesh.
Strikes from ambush unless target passes a PSY Save.
combat_note: Ambush predator; target may avoid surprise with a PSY save.
raw_excerpt: GlassCentipede Biological Level AV Morale 1 12 +5 Attack:Bite(d6TOX) Four-footcentipedewithtranslucentflesh.Strikes fromambushunlesstargetpassesaPSYSave.

name: Spawn of An-Rah's Guts
special: Octopus-like creature, formed from fungus and An-Rah's intestines.
Wears the remains of its canopic jar like a hat.
raw_excerpt: SpawnofAn-Rah'sGuts Fungal Level AV Morale 2 13 +10 Attack:Lash(d6)/AcidSpit(d6) Octopus-likecreature,formedfromfungusandAn-Rah'sintestines.Wearstheremainsofitscanopicjar likeahat.

name: Spawn of An-Rah's Brain
special: Fungal brain that walks on two tiny legs. Wears the remains of its canopic jar like a hat.
Attempts to psychically dominate opponents, Opposed EGO save to resist mind control.
Dominated PCs are forced to make attacks against their fellow vault-raiders.
combat_note: Opposed EGO save to resist domination; dominated PCs attack their allies.

name: Dogsbody
special: An amalgam of Rappash-Ik's DNA with that of his favourite hunting dog.
Black-furred hounds with the face of the dead Autarch.
Speak in repetitive parroted phrases and follow Janus devotedly.
If Janus dies they will accept his killer as their pack leader, showing their bellies in submission.

name: Janitor Synth
special: Boxy trundling cleaning synth.
Will attempt to dispose of any dead bodies within the facility and take them to the incinerator.
Cannot speak, uninterested in living beings.
combat_note: Attack listed as n/a; non-combatant.
raw_excerpt: JanitorSynth Synthetic LVL1(4HP)/AV12/ML+10/ENCd6 Attack:n/a Boxy trundling cleaning synth.

name: Janus
special: Towering, heavily-muscled cannibal. One cunning 'old' head and one foolish new one, created by grafting the head of an elderly clone onto a fresh Weekling.
Begrudgingly subservient towards Mimir; each believes they are the 'true' Autarch.
Styles himself 'Autarch' and will fly into a rage if not addressed as such.
Eats only the flesh of Weeklings.
Carries the Red Keycard and would die before giving it up.
Able to pass through the Laser Hallways without triggering the trap, and will use this to escape from battles that have gone poorly.
combat_note: Physically strong and aggressive; attacks with Dogsbody support, attempts to capture PCs alive for meat.

name: Mimir
special: A severed head, with the features and voice of Rappash-Ik. Suspended in a vat of biotic gel. Moves on slender mechanical limbs.
Believes himself to be the actual head of Rappash-Ik (untrue); is the experiment of a previous Autarch clone.
Master of the Fount; has extended his lifespan by preserving himself in his contraption.
Must recharge his tank in his Laboratory once per day or become immobilised and perish.
Carries the Purple Keycard and would die before giving it up.
No match for the PCs in combat; will seek to bargain, outwit, and use the Fount's traps against them.
combat_note: Avoids direct combat; bargains, flees to control room, sends Janus and Dogsbodies.

name: Weekling
special: Emaciated, mindless clones of Rappash-Ik. Naked, with the minds of feral, unlettered beasts.
Farmed for meat by Janus and Mimir.
The Weeklings hate their captors and will kill them if they can.

name: Mayor Zuljan Afi
special: Cacogen patriarch of the House of Circumspect Navigators, and Mayor of Caeba. Short, affable, bearded with carp-like tendrils.
Possesses an item of Exotica: a Compass of Origin.

name: Iriyah Afi
special: Cacogen. Zuljan's wife. Matron of the House of Circumspect Navigators.
One incredibly long arm, with flesh the texture of dough. Practical and profit-minded.

name: Warden Stoll
special: Cacogen. Bondsman of the Afi family. Vigilant enforcer. Dour, centaur-like warrior. Smokes cigarillos.

name: Crumbhornet
special: Mycomorph. Bondsman of the Afi family. Friendly and adventurous; will be eager to explore the Grandfather's guts alongside the PCs.
Born from the corpse of a condemned kin-slayer. On the run from the Hegemony, as it is illegal to resurrect anyone who was sentenced to death.
combat_note: Targeted by bounty hunter Blotte with a fungicide-coated spear.

name: Petrichor
special: Scholar from the Lithic Lyceum. Quiet, cautious, pedantic. Crystalline flesh the colour of apricots.
Studying stone-eating lithophage worms. Glad to be accompanied into the Grandfather's guts by research assistants.

name: The Marvellous Incandenza
special: Travelling synthetic con-artist and stage magician. Boastful, flamboyant and immoral.
Has a large glass head, full of bulbs that light up as he thinks.
Planning to rob Mayor Zuljan of his Compass.

name: Dimbulb
special: Incandenza's assistant. Same model as Incandenza, but can only think at half the speed due to broken processors.
The bulbs in his head are visibly duller. Monosyllabic and obedient.
combat_note: Stage Sword deals a flat 1 damage.

name: Blotte
special: A bumbling, overconfident true-kin bounty hunter, mounted on Thunder.
Arrives at Caeba a day after the PCs, seeking to kill Crumbhornet with a spear coated in fungicide.
combat_note: Carries a fungicide-coated spear (anti-fungal); relevant vs Crumbhornet.

name: Thunder
special: A jet-black, merciless elephant bird.
Constantly saves Blotte's life, without her master ever being aware of this fact.
Item Slots 50.
combat_note: Stat line also lists Item Slots 50.

name: Lanchra, the Pale Shadow
special: Ruthless planeywoman assassin, dispatched to kill Blotte by a former client he ripped off.
Looks like a cubist painting of a gaunt, battle-scarred woman wearing white.
Fights by pulling out her hair and throwing it at her victims; the 2D filaments slice through armour and flesh like cheese-wire.
Arrives six hours after Blotte and Thunder, aboard a seemingly-empty skiff.

resistances.notes: Hair Strand attack hits as though the target's AV = 10 (bypasses/ignores most armour); this is an attack mechanic, not a defensive resistance of Lanchra.

combat_note: Hair Strand resolves against AV 10 regardless of target's actual AV (armour-piercing).

name: Lithophage Worm
special: Will only attack to consume stone.
combat_note: Passive unless consuming stone; appears as d6 in encounter table and 4 in Ballast Stomach Major.

name: Iridium Vulture
special: Synthetic scavengers who float through Urth's atmosphere in pursuit of the scent of death.
Feasting on sandworm flesh. Territorial, but easily appeased with meat.

name: Lost Caeba Worker
special: Terrified and thirsty. Demand a share of your rations.

name: Buzzblade Drone
special: Like plasteel toddlers with chainsaw arms. Listlessly searching for something to cut up.

name: Bacteria Gestalt Colony
special: Targets absorbed take d8 damage each round until they make an opposed STR save.
The colony takes minimum damage from physical attacks.
Vulnerable to fungal spores or other sources of antibiotics.
Aware of the Grandfather's demise and now in the early stages of devouring one another (three colonies: Alpha, Theta, Omega).
All are psychic and communicate in staccato bursts of telepathic imagery. Slow-moving and quick to turn against one another.

resistances.notes: Text states it 'takes minimum damage from physical attacks' (mapped physical -> kinetic/bludgeoning/slashing/piercing). 'Vulnerable to fungal spores or other sources of antibiotics' recorded as a stated weakness (mapped to fungal_spores; fungicide as antibiotic synonym). No other resistance stated.

combat_note: Minimum damage from physical attacks; vulnerable to fungal spores/antibiotics; ongoing absorb damage until opposed STR save.

name: Oviraptor Beetle
special: Plated egg-eating beetles. Aggressive and stupid.
Fanatically attack anything egg-shaped.

name: Megacilia
special: Symbiotic creatures that aided in the filtration of the Grandfather's ingested sand.
Slowly dying but remain vital.
Grasp moving objects and identify them; biological or metallic objects are carried towards the Metal Stomach, minerals towards the Ballast Stomach Minor.
Resisting the Megacilia requires an opposed STR save.

resistances.notes: Stat block uses 'HD 10' rather than a Level value; recorded HD in raw_excerpt. Morale printed as '15' (no sign).

combat_note: Stat line gives HD 10 (not Level); nonlethal grasp lists no damage value. Morale shown as 15.

name: Mereth
special: A synthetic alchemist who entered the Grandfather centuries ago to gather bile.
Has become stuck in the Major Bile Gland's wall, and the flesh is beginning to encyst her.
Believes herself to have become one with 'the Godflesh' and will violently resist attempts to rescue her.
Her screams draw a guaranteed Encounter.
Carries a bottle of Doppeldraught in her robes.

resistances.notes: Stat block uses 'HD 1' rather than a Level value.

combat_note: Stat line gives HD 1 (not Level).

name: Kander New-Ocelot
special: Long dark coat and wide-brimmed hat. Two gaudy guns. Cautious, cunning, cruel. Leader of the bandits.
If Kander dies, all other bandits must make a Morale Save.
Carries a Wand of Annihilation, although he values it for its gaudy appearance and does not know how to use it.
combat_note: Bandit leader; brawler. Death triggers Morale Save for the rest of the gang.

name: Plandysour New-Wolf
special: Sniper and lookout. Engages at range.
In close quarters she will deploy a smoke bomb (blast, d4 rounds of blindness) and attempt to retreat.
Will attempt to flank from a side angle and use her powerful rifle to pick off distracted opponents.
combat_note: Smoke bomb causes blast blindness for d4 rounds.

name: Marturo New-Raven
special: Brash, fearless, physically imposing. Will spearhead any attack with his chaingun.
If the bandits are losing a fight, Marturo will cover the others while they escape.
combat_note: Front-line brawler with blast chaingun.

name: Oskandre New-Python

attacks.name: Constrict
attacks.damage: d10 ongoing, STR Save to break free

special: Lazy, greedy, bloated from eating dead Faa.
Brawler; will seek to engage foes head-on.
combat_note: Constrict deals d10 ongoing; victim escapes with a STR save.
raw_excerpt: OskandreNew-Python Biological LVL3(12HP)/AV14/ML+7 Attack: Pistol (d6) / Constrict (d10 ongoing, STR Savetobreakfree)

name: Nadimir New-Mantis
special: A chitinous mystic. Outside of combat he is soft-spoken and dreamy.
Force Bubble: Nadimir projects a psychic barrier around another creature, raising their AV to 20. He must renew this effect each round.
Will stay behind the brawlers and use his Force Bubble to protect Marturo or Oskandre.
combat_note: Force Bubble raises an ally's AV to 20, renewed each round.
raw_excerpt: NadimirNew-Mantis Biological/Psychic LVL1(4HP)/AV11/ML+3 Attack:Telekinesis(d8)/ForceBubble(Special) ForceBubble:Nadimirprojectsapsychicbarrier around another creature, raising theirAV to 20.

name: Corpser New-Octopus
special: Can perfectly match the colour of his surroundings, rendering him invisible so long as he is not moving.
Prefers to attack from ambush; will always run if he is spotted.
Can deploy a Porta-warden turret to cover his escape or catch opponents in crossfire.
combat_note: Camouflage invisibility while stationary; ambusher.
raw_excerpt: CorpserNew-Octopus Biological LVL1(4HP)/AV11/ML+0 Attack:TentacleChoke(d6) Corpser can perfectly match the colour of his surroundings, rendering him invisible so long as heisnotmoving.

name: Porta-Warden
special: Motion-sensor tripod with mounted weapon.
Recognises its master via DNA locking. This could be subverted if the Porta-warden were provided with new DNA from blood or hair.
combat_note: DNA-locked turret; can be subverted with new DNA from blood or hair.
raw_excerpt: Porta-Warden Synthetic LVL2(8HP)/AV13/ML- Attack:Autorifle(d8) Motion-sensor tripod with mounted weapon. RecognisesitsmasterviaDNAlocking.
